hypothesis: Among assets already in material drawdowns, confirmed upward recovery geometry predicts relative continuation while renewed downward drawdown geometry predicts relative underperformance.
falsifier: The thesis is falsified if the recovery-confirmed long sleeve does not beat the renewed-drawdown short sleeve after costs across development folds or if returns are explained by drawdown depth without recovery-state confirmation.
formation_horizon: 84 calendar days of completed 8h closes, including 12-day recovery and 4-day confirmation regressions
control_profile: dollar-neutral 1.0 gross targets, two-to-three names per side, volatility scaling, drawdown brakes, and a 0.20 one-way turnover cap
